changes.comment: Adds an upgrade guide for 0.7.x to 0.8.0, in English and Spanish, and corrects the migration guide's description of middleware, which still said it returns a boolean. The existing migration guide covers arriving from Redux, Zustand or Jotai and had nothing about moving between Yoltra versions, which this release needs: five behaviour changes and a hazard on rollback are hard to extract from a list of thirty changelog entries. Each section leads with how you would notice.
